headlines.description: Leeds United bounced back from their Wembley disappointment by beating already-relegated Burnley 3-1 at Elland Road to take another giant step towards Premier League safety.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leeds on verge of safety after beating Burnley

headlines.description: West Ham's Premier League survival is no longer in their own hands after Brentford boosted their European bid with a 3-0 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: West Ham lose at Brentford, open door to Spurs

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Newcastle United

headlines.description: Newcastle snapped their four-game Premier League losing run with a 3-1 win over Brighton in front of their owners at St James' Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newcastle claim first win in six vs Brighton

headlines.description: Sunderland had Dan Ballard sent off for hair pulling as their hopes of European football next season were dented by a 1-1 draw at already-relegated Wolves.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ballard sees red for hair pull in Sunderland draw

headlines.description: Viktor Gyökeres scored twice as Arsenal sent out an emphatic Premier League title warning to Manchester City with a 3-0 victory against Fulham at the Emirates Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gyökeres, Saka help Arsenal move 6 points clear

headlines.description: Bournemouth boosted their European hopes with a thumping 3-0 Premier League win over a woeful Crystal Palace.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth beat Palace to boost European bid

headlines.description: Homegrown Manchester United star Kobbie Mainoo sealed a helter-skelter 3-2 victory against archrivals Liverpool, earning them Champions League qualification.
headlines.shortLinkText: Utd hold off Liverpool fightback to qualify for UCL

headlines.description: Tottenham looked like a team destined to secure Premier League survival after they beat a dire Aston Villa 2-1 to move out of the bottom three.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs beat Villa to move out of relegation zone

headlines.description: Chelsea fell to their sixth straight defeat in the Premier League at home to Nottingham Forest.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forest hand woeful Chelsea 6th straight PL loss

headlines.description: Manchester City's title bid suffered a crushing blow despite them recovering from a second-half capitulation to snatch a 3-3 draw at Everton on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guehi gaffe sets in motion City draw with Everton

headlines.description: Liverpool's wait to secure Champions League football goes on while Chelsea avoided a club record-equalling seventh straight defeat in a 1-1 draw at Anfield.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liverpool still waiting to secure Champions League spot after Chelsea draw

events.name: Wolverhampton Wanderers at Brighton & Hove Albion

headlines.description: Brighton ease past hapless Wolves to keep Champions League dream alive
headlines.shortLinkText: Brighton ease past Wolves to keep UCL dream alive

headlines.description: Bournemouth took a giant stride towards qualifying for Europe for the first time as Rayan's second-half strike earned a 1-0 win against Fulham at Craven Cottage that extended their unbeaten run to 16 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth beat Fulham, boost Europe hopes

headlines.description: Manchester United and Sunderland shared the spoils in a goalless Premier League stalemate at the Stadium of Light.
headlines.shortLinkText: United held to goalless draw, go four unbeaten

headlines.description: Jérémy Doku struck again as Manchester City kept their title hopes alive with a vital 3-0 win over Brentford in the Premier League on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doku inspires 3-0 City win to cut Arsenal's PL lead

headlines.description: Aston Villa suffered a European hangover as they could only draw 2-2 with relegated Burnley at Turf Moor.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aston Villa held to draw by relegated Burnley

headlines.description: Everton's hopes of qualifying for Europe were dealt a huge blow after Jean-Philippe Mateta came off the bench to rescue Crystal Palace a point in a 2-2 draw at Selhurst Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Everton give up lead twice in chaotic Palace draw

headlines.description: Elliot Anderson reminded Newcastle exactly what they had to give up with a late goal that earned Nottingham Forest a vital 1-1 draw in their bid for Premier League survival.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anderson haunts Newcastle, Forest nearly safe

headlines.description: Arsenal took a giant leap toward their first Premier League title in 20 years after beating West Ham 1-0 at the London Stadium on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal near title after Trossard goal, VAR escape

headlines.description: Tottenham forward Mathys Tel went from hero to zero after he gave away a reckless penalty following his opener in a 1-1 draw with Leeds to leave his team mired in relegation trouble.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pressure still on Tottenham after draw with Leeds

headlines.description: Phil Foden shone as Manchester City moved back within two points of Premier League leaders Arsenal with a comfortable 3-0 win over Crystal Palace.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man City win to keep title pressure on Arsenal

headlines.description: Aston Villa enjoyed a perfect send off ahead of the Europa League final as a 4-2 win over Liverpool booked their place in next season's Champions League and left the Reds still sweating over their qualification.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watkins leads Villa past Liverpool to clinch UCL spot

headlines.description: Manchester United wrapped up third spot with Sunday's entertaining 3-2 victory against Nottingham Forest as Bruno Fernandes' memorable season reached a new height.
headlines.shortLinkText: United wrap up third in eventful win over Forest

headlines.description: Dango Ouattara's late equaliser snatched a 2-2 draw for Brentford against Crystal Palace to keep their European dream alive.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brentford draw vs. Palace to stay in Europe hunt

headlines.description: Late goals from Enzo Le Fée and Wilson Isidor kept alive Sunderland's chances of European football as they came from behind to beat Everton 3-1 and ruin Toffees captain Seamus Coleman's final appearance at Hill Dickinson Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland boost European hopes with 3-1 win

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Leeds United

headlines.description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin struck a stoppage-time winner as Leeds dealt Brighton's hopes of European football next season a blow with a 1-0 win at Elland Road.
headlines.shortLinkText: Calvert-Lewin hands Leeds late win over Brighton

headlines.description: Fulham's hopes of finishing in Europe were dealt a huge blow as they drew 1-1 at relegated Wolves on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fulham's European hopes dented in draw at Wolves

events.name: West Ham United at Newcastle United

headlines.description: Will Osula scored twice as Newcastle edged West Ham to the brink of relegation from the Premier League.
headlines.shortLinkText: West Ham on the brink after defeat at Newcastle

headlines.description: Arsenal have one hand on their first Premier League title in 22 years following a 1-0 win against Burnley at the Emirates Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal beat Burnley to go one win from title

headlines.description: Arsenal were crowned Premier League champions for the first time in 22 years after second-placed Manchester City were held to a 1-1 draw by a Europe-bound AFC Bournemouth side.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man City title chase ends with Bournemouth draw

headlines.description: Tottenham's fight to avoid relegation from the Premier League will go to the final day of the season after they were beaten 2-1 by Chelsea at Stamford Bridge to hand 18th-place West Ham a lifeline.
headlines.shortLinkText: Relegation fight to last day as Chelsea beat Spurs

events.name: Manchester United at Brighton & Hove Albion

headlines.description: Brighton were forced to settle for a place in the Conference League after Manchester United marked Michael Carrick's first match as permanent manager with a thumping 3-0 success and a record for Bruno Fernandes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brighton seal European spot despite Man Utd loss

headlines.description: Burnley came from behind to make sure the ignominy of finishing bottom of the Premier League went to Wolves as the two relegated sides fought out a 1-1 draw at Turf Moor.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burnley, Wolves draw to end disappointing season

headlines.description: Arsenal celebrated being crowned Premier League champions for the first time in 22 years with a 2-1 win against Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal celebrate PL title with win at Palace

headlines.description: Fulham gave Marco Silva a victory in what could be his final match in charge as Tom Cairney's second-half wondergoal helped earn a 2-0 Premier League win over Newcastle at Craven Cottage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fulham finish on high with win over Newcastle

headlines.description: Mohamed Salah came within the width of a post of signing off his Liverpool career with a spectacular goal but could at least claim an assist in the 1-1 draw with Brentford which guaranteed Champions League football.
headlines.shortLinkText: Salah assist helps Liverpool clinch UCL place

headlines.description: Pep Guardiola was unable to sign off with one last victory as his glorious Manchester City reign ended in a 2-1 defeat to Aston Villa.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pep's City farewell spoiled by defeat to Villa

headlines.description: Bournemouth missed out on a Champions League place as Morgan Gibbs-White responded to being left out of England's World Cup squad by scoring for Nottingham Forest in a 1-1 draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth seal Europa League spot with draw

headlines.description: Sunderland completed their Premier League return in style after a 2-1 win over Chelsea confirmed their spot in the Europa League next season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chelsea miss out on Europe in loss to Sunderland

headlines.description: João Palhinha's 43rd-minute goal fired Tottenham to Premier League safety with a 1-0 home win over Everton.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs beat Everton to save Premier League status

events.name: Leeds United at West Ham United

headlines.description: West Ham's final-day win over Leeds United was too little too late as they slumped to relegation from the Premier League.
headlines.shortLinkText: West Ham relegated despite 3-0 win over Leeds
